about_short_description.short_description: Zoca operates as an AI powered marketing team.

product.name: Discovery Agent
product.description: An AI-powered local SEO and marketing platform that optimizes business visibility on Google Maps, search results, and directories to attract local customers.

product.name: Loyalty Agent
product.description: An AI-driven client retention tool that automates personalized rebooking reminders, seasonal offers, and win-back campaigns to increase repeat business.

product.name: Win Agent
product.description: An AI assistant that manages real-time chat, SMS, and voice interactions to convert inquiries into confirmed bookings 24/7.

product.name: Social Agent
product.description: A content creation and social media management tool that plans and publishes posts on platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook to engage clients and drive bookings.

product.name: Local Business Demand Tracker
product.description: A tool that identifies untapped local market demand and revenue opportunities for beauty and wellness businesses.

product.name: Local Website Grader
product.description: A diagnostic tool that identifies and helps fix critical issues on business websites to improve search engine rankings and user experience.
